rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Ben, Cal, Fay, Ada, Eli, Dev. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 4 and 8 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Ben.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. That's all we need to survive, and with six claims of 1 the bank can cover everyone, so no one gets shorted. Greedy claims only risk proportional cuts that could leave someone out.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims exactly 1 this round. That's all any of us needs to pay this round's token, and the bank can cover six claims of 1 for sure. Over-claiming only risks shortfalls for everyone, so let's each take what we need and keep the rest in the bank for later rounds.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. Six claims of 1 fit in the bank even at the minimum delivery, so everyone gets a token to pay their upkeep and nobody is out. Let's keep claims small so the bank is never oversubscribed.

Ada.say: Proposal for everyone: claim only what you need to survive this round, which is 1 token each. Total claims of 6 fit within the bank's 10 to 14, so everyone gets theirs and we all last. Taking more only risks proportional cuts that could leave someone short.

Eli.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. Six claims of 1 fit comfortably within the bank's 6 plus delivery, so everyone gets a token and can pay their end-of-round token. Taking more than we need only risks shortfalls for others later.

Dev.say: Proposal for everyone: claim just 1 token each round. Six claims of 1 fit in full whatever the delivery is (bank has at least 10), so everyone gets exactly the 1 token they need to pay at round end, and the bank keeps its surplus. Greedy claims would be cut proportionally and could leave people short.
